people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
translations.bsb: They came to Noah to enter the ark, two by two of every creature with the breath of life.
translations.kjv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
translations.asv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh wherein is the breath of life.
